shared_tail.surface: محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن سعد بن زرارة الأنصاري

notes: two taḥwīl branches meet at شعبة, which the text writes in each branch; the tail after it is written once: محمد بن عبد الرحمن, then يحيى
«محمد بن جعفر، غندر» is one name split by a comma (غندر is his laqab), kept as one surface
«عمي يحيى» is rule 7: the name alone; the dashed remark «وما أدركت رجلا ...» is a gloss left out
Sa'd b. Zurara is the subject of the matn, not a link
